stat: Annual staff-hours saving implied by scaling NHS England's Microsoft 365 Copilot trial time-saving to the full 500,000-staff rollout
applies_to: clusters: Operations & Efficiency; UK Industry Verticals
method: Recipe A-style scaling — multiplying a published per-person time-saving figure by a published rollout headcount and a standard working-year assumption, a total the source did not publish itself

sources_used.title: 500,000 NHS staff to get new artificial intelligence tools to help free up more time for patients
NHS accelerates artificial intelligence rollout to cut waiting times and improve care for millions

workings: NHS England's Microsoft 365 Copilot trial (90 organisations, 30,000+ staff) found an average saving of at least 43 minutes of staff time per person per day. Scaled to the 500,000 staff targeted for the full rollout by October 2026: 43 minutes x 500,000 staff = 21,500,000 minutes/day = 358,333 hours/day. Applying a standard assumed 220-day NHS working year (a Tom & Co assumption, not an NHS-published figure): 358,333 x 220 = approximately 78,833,333 hours/year, rounded to roughly 79 million hours a year. NHS England has not published this national annualised total itself.
